races.name: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HOSEKI is very much going the right way and can show she's still ahead of the handicapper. Pendella is solid and is second choice ahead of the prolific Supplicate.

  1. HOSEKI (IRE)
  2. PENDELLA (IRE)
  3. SUPPLICATE

races.name: 200,000 Pound Tattersalls October Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good chance for NIGHT IN VEGAS to land a third valuable pot in a row. Zigazig Ah chased him home in a similar race on the July Course here at the end of the summer and can give him most to think about again. Woodhay Wayfarer has a steadily progressive profile and may prove best of the remainder.

  1. NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)
  2. ZIGAZIG AH
  3. WOODHAY WAYFARER (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM Sun Chariot Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 1)
races.verdict:
BLUE BOLT can't be opposed as she bids for a fourth successive Group 1 win. City of Memphis followed her home in the Matron and may do so again. Kon Tiki was behind a few of these in the Atalanta at Sandown but that was on a soft surface and she may prove best of the rest if back to the level of her Group 3 success on fast ground at Ascot prior to that.

  1. BLUE BOLT (IRE)
  2. CITY OF MEMPHIS (IRE)
  3. KON TIKI

races.name: HKJC World Pool Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
EVANESCO has developed into a smart handicapper and can resume winning ways on the back of a cracking run in Ireland. The main danger could be Old Newton Cup winner Sportingsilvermine, who's enjoyed a largely stellar season for the excellent James Owen team, with Primo Lara also respected in his current vein of form.

  1. EVANESCO
  2. SPORTINGSILVERMINE (IRE)
  3. PRIMO LARA (IRE)

races.name: Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An intriguing maiden despite the small field. KICKING BEAR shaped with abundant promise amidst inexperience when second on his Newbury debut 38 days ago, impressing with the way he picked up and stuck to his task behind one with prior experience. He looks a sure-fire improver and can get off the mark. Charlie Appleby has landed the last 2 renewals of this race and his Altius may emerge as the lead threat.

  1. KICKING BEAR (FR)
  2. ALTIUS
  3. AFIF (FR)

races.name: BetMGM EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby boasts a healthy strike with his 2-y-o newcomers, so his MUBLISH, a €2,250,000 son of Frankel is narrowly selected to come out on top over Royal Quest, who shaped with a good deal of promise when fourth on debut at Doncaster and ought to give the selection plenty to think about.

  1. MUBLISH (IRE)
  2. ROYAL QUEST (IRE)
  3. CHAPEL STREAM

races.name: Experience The Thrill With Kennet Valley Syndicates Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A 4-time winner this season, VELVET RHYTHM has looked back at the top of her game on her last 2 starts and she can build on those efforts to add to her tally. The main danger could be Starlight Lass, who had excuses in her hat-trick bid last time, with Woohoo also in the mix.

  1. VELVET RHYTHM
  2. STARLIGHT LASS
  3. WOOHOO (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV EBF Stallions Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CHARTED COURSE sets a very good standard and this costly breeze-up purchase is fancied to go one better than his Goodwood second last time out and gain a first win at the chief expense of Green Star who shaped well when a debut runner-up at Chester. Both Crystal Dark and Bombora are in very good hands and also enter the reckoning after promising respective debut efforts at Newcastle and Doncaster.

  1. CHARTED COURSE
  2. GREEN STAR (IRE)
  3. CRYSTAL DARK

races.name: Prohibition Bar Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
YAFAARR took a step forward in refitted cheekpieces when going in over 1m here last time and can enhance his excellent course record by defying a 4 lb rise in the weights. Woodleigh is also to be greatly respected at this track and is feared most ahead of Bradbury and Sunny Orange.

  1. YAFAARR (IRE)
  2. WOODLEIGH (IRE)
  3. BRADBURY (IRE)

races.name: Prohibition Bar Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Marginal preference is for LADY HORNBLOWER who benefited from the fitting of a visor when going in over C&D last time and remains likely capable of better over this trip having largely been campaigned at up to 1m previously. Kartini is feared most having slipped to a lenient-looking mark, while Bay Dream Believer and Tommo's Ginjaninja also need factoring into this tight-knit handicap.

  1. LADY HORNBLOWER
  2. KARTINI (IRE)
  3. BAY DREAM BELIEVER (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Two Year Old Trophy (Listed)
races.verdict:
SATELLITE OF LOVE and Revels stand out on form here and Clive Cox's Minzaal colt edges the vote on the back of a fine clear second in a valuable sales event at Doncaster over Karl Burke's Mill Reef fourth. Both Thames Waterman and Myesme are less exposed and arrive on the back of impressive wins at Wolverhampton and Beverley respectively so shouldn't be underestimated in a cracking renewal of the Two-Year-Old Trophy.

  1. SATELLITE OF LOVE (IRE)
  2. REVELS
  3. THAMES WATERMAN

races.name: John Smith's EBF Stallions Guisborough Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
None can be dismissed in a cracking listed event but Ralph Beckett's low-mileage 5-y-o VALVANO impressed when returning from an absence to score at Southwell (form been well advertised) and he gets the vote with better still likely to come. Elarak is proving ultra consistent this season and could emerge as the chief threat, although Sondad holds very good form claims if his stamina holds out. C&D scorer Vafortino is another well in the mix.

  1. VALVANO (IRE)
  2. ELARAK
  3. SONDAD

races.name: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight-Mile Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
Two-time C&D winner CLASSIC ENCOUNTER has strong form claims and may well land a nice pot for shrewd connections. Law Of Design looks the chief threat off his much-reduced mark, while Double Parked is closely matched with the selection on their form from earlier in the season here. Fellow C&D winners Welbury and Rajapour also merit consideration.

  1. CLASSIC ENCOUNTER (IRE)
  2. LAW OF DESIGN (IRE)
  3. DOUBLE PARKED (IRE)

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
It could pay to concentrate on the unexposed 3-y-o stayers, with NORTHERN BRAVE marginally preferred to turf debutant Pace Attack, following an improved showing in headgear at Hamilton last time. According To Mark looks on a handy opening mark but has hinted at temperament.

  1. NORTHERN BRAVE (IRE)
  2. PACE ATTACK (IRE)
  3. ACCORDING TO MARK (IRE)

races.name: Watch Race Replays On racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
This could set up perfectly for ZIGGY'S TRITON and Mo Of Cairo, with David O'Meara's charge narrowly preferred to his 3-y-o counterpart. Emperor Caradoc and Dolos Dream are no back numbers, either, in what looks a competitive sprint.

  1. ZIGGY'S TRITON (IRE)
  2. MO OF CAIRO
  3. EMPEROR CARADOC (FR)

races.name: Qatar Arabian Trophy Des Juments (Arab Group 1)
Qatar Prix de la Place des Vosges Handicap
Arqana Series - Haras de Bouquetot Criterium d'Automne Stakes
Qatar Prix de la Place de la Concorde Handicap
BetMGM British EBF October Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
SO REGAL has quickly progressed into a useful filly, shaping encouragingly after 4 months off when not beaten far in a Group 3 at Sandown in August. She represents last year's winning stable/owners (Cheveley Park also landed the prize in 2024) and can gain a first black-type success, at the expense of last year's runner-up Dash of Azure. Midnight Tango completes the shortlist.

  1. SO REGAL
  2. DASH OF AZURE
  3. MIDNIGHT TANGO

races.name: BetMGM Rous Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
TUCO SALAMANCA sets a clear standard on his first foray into listed company following another personal best from a lofty handicap rating when second in the Ayr Gold Cup a fortnight ago. Last year's winner Shagraan returned to his best fitted with first-time cheekpieces when third in a Group 3 at Newbury recently and should give another good account if the headgear works as well for a second time. Fluorescence has made good strides forward this season and completes the shortlist.

  1. TUCO SALAMANCA (IRE)
  2. SHAGRAAN (IRE)
  3. FLUORESCENCE

races.name: BetMGM Cumberland Lodge Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
TENABILITY continues to go from strength to strength for the excellent William Haggas yard, and he looks poised to land a fourth C&D success. The main threat could come from Royal Power, who goes well fresh and is a very smart performer on his day.

  1. TENABILITY
  2. ROYAL POWER (FR)
  3. AL AASY (IRE)

races.name: John Guest Racing Bengough Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
DIVISION has raised his game appreciably this year, shaping well when just touched off in the Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville on his most recent outing and earns the vote to register a deserved success back down in grade. Prince of India capitalised on a drop in grade with a dominant performance at Newmarket 6 weeks ago and looks sure to go well again, while Hidden Force is a most intriguing runner having not been seen since finishing third in the Craven Stakes back in the spring.

  1. DIVISION
  2. PRINCE OF INDIA (IRE)
  3. HIDDEN FORCE

races.name: BetMGM Challenge Cup (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
MOONFALL enjoyed his finest hour when landing the Britannia at Royal Ascot and can build on recent promise off a still handy-looking mark to bag another prestigious handicap here. Thunder Call put himself firmly in the picture for this when a ready C&D scorer last time and rates the biggest threat, although plenty of others can also play a prominent role, notably Aalto, Hawksbill, Machadadorp and Hickory in this superb renewal.

  1. MOONFALL (IRE)
  2. THUNDER CALL
  3. AALTO (FR)

races.name: Ascot Iron Stand Membership Handicap
races.verdict:
MAELSTROM got back on the up for current connections with wins at Newmarket and this C&D in August/September, so he's well worth another chance having had excuses at Doncaster last time. He gets the vote ahead of Gold Star Hero, who was denied late on by the selection here last month, with Adrestia also considered on the back of her latest effort.

  1. MAELSTROM
  2. GOLD STAR HERO (IRE)
  3. ADRESTIA

races.name: KSR Lighting Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
OF CORSE I CAN bounced back to form with a game success over C&D last month and he remains only 1 lb higher than for this win in this race last year. He is taken to see off the challenge of Broadway Honey, who has made a positive start over fences for the in-form Twiston-Davies stable.

  1. OF CORSE I CAN (FR)
  2. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE)
  3. MCGREGORS CHARGE

races.name: Finbarr OSullivan 21st Carpe Diem Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Irish raider EBEN ZAABEEL has seemingly benefited from the application of a tongue strap in recent starts, travelling best from some way out when making his second hurdles start a winning one at Downpatrick 33 days ago. He does need to brush up on his jumping but can do better still if doing so and earns the vote to follow up under Sean Bowen. Down To Business back down in trip rates next best. Anniversary and Aquaman are hurdles newcomers to note.

  1. EBEN ZAABEEL
  2. DOWN TO BUSINESS
  3. ANNIVERSARY

races.name: Nick Peacock Eighty Shades Of Grey Birthday Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SALKADAN appeared much more focused equipped with cheekpieces when making all over C&D 5 weeks ago and he may well be up to defying a penalty. Fellow last-time-out winner Royal Sapphire is an obvious threat, while Our Wee Horse appeals as a likely newcomer from the Harry Derham yard and confidence behind him in the betting would need to be viewed positively.

  1. SALKADAN
  2. ROYAL SAPPHIRE (IRE)
  3. OUR WEE HORSE (IRE)

races.name: Colin Johnson's 70th Birthday Celebrations Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Preference is for MOVE WITH THE BEAT who has got the hang of things as a chaser with 4 wins from his last 5 starts. He can pick up where he left off to add to his tally, though A Little Something is one to note despite having failed to complete on her last 3 outings (looked the likely winner on first 2 occasions).

  1. MOVE WITH THE BEAT (IRE)
  2. A LITTLE SOMETHING
  3. MIDNIGHT JEWEL

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CROWN OF INDIA shaped as if still in form behind a trio of next-time-out winners at Worcester last time and likely has a fitness edge on several of the main protagonists. He narrowly shades the vote over interesting stable-switcher Diamond Egg, with Desert Halo and Birthday Angel also appealing on return.

  1. CROWN OF INDIA (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND EGG (FR)
  3. DESERT HALO (IRE)

races.name: Southern Cranes And Access Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JEFE TRIUNFO capitalised on his falling mark under a good ride from Freddie Gordon last time. This could again pan out favourably and he may well up to defying a 5 lb rise. Aggagio is certainly well treated if putting it all together up in trip and he's feared most in a trappy race.

  1. JEFE TRIUNFO (FR)
  2. AGGAGIO (FR)
  3. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)

races.name: KEP Communications Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COUNTY CHAMPS was in the process of showing the benefit of his recent stable debut when departing here last month, likely to have won but for falling 2 out, and he can gain compensation this time around. No Mean Feat finally got off the mark at this course recently and is feared most, ahead of Winston's Oath.

  1. COUNTY CHAMPS (IRE)
  2. NO MEAN FEAT (IRE)
  3. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Compare Before You Bet Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXOPHONIC was a revelation over 1¾m at Wolverhampton last time and there may be even more to come at 2m. The thriving Captain Cairney is the obvious form threat, with Tinkety Tonk one to note for market support now handicapping.

  1. SAXOPHONIC
  2. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY
  3. TINKETY TONK

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Best Betting Offers Nursery
races.verdict:
A 2 lb nudge for her recent Chester near miss looks fair so ABSOLUTE DIAMOND may prove the answer to this nursery. Prince Kameo has thrived of late and is second choice ahead of Agitator and the class-dropping Roosike.

  1. ABSOLUTE DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. PRINCE KAMEO
  3. AGITATOR

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
Perhaps best to focus on the 3-y-os, with WID taken to build on her encouraging handicap debut in a big field at Glorious Goodwood. Siwa Oasis has had the form of his Leicester novice success boosted and is next on the list ahead of Andrew Balding's Magic Trip.

  1. WID (IRE)
  2. SIWA OASIS (IRE)
  3. MAGIC TRIP

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk New Customer Offers Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DONTWORRYABOUTME improved markedly from debut when second here last time and will be hard to beat if reproducing that effort. Notimetotakeoff has a similar profile and rates the chief threat, while Maliqui remains open to improvement. Son Of Vega makes plenty of appeal on paper, though 2-y-o debut winners are quite rare for the yard, so market strength would be notable.

  1. DONTWORRYABOUTME (IRE)
  2. NOTIMETOTAKEOFF (IRE)
  3. MALIQUI (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Free Bet Offers Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CLOUD FOREST has filled the runner-up spot in 3 of his 4 starts and improved for the latest of them over 1m at Newbury in August. He is taken to make the breakthrough in first-time cheekpieces. Imperial Ballet looked potentially useful when winning on debut last August and rates the chief danger, though she may need this return. All You Can Be shaped with promise despite greenness on debut and can improve in a first-time hood.

  1. CLOUD FOREST
  2. IMPERIAL BALLET
  3. ALL YOU CAN BE (USA)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Every Bookie Compared Handicap
races.verdict:
NEW IMAGE is another Michael Herrington has quickly found the key to and he can land a second C&D success in a week. The hat-trick seeking Horace Wallace and former C&D winners Jenever and Kats Bob may give him most to do.

  1. NEW IMAGE
  2. HORACE WALLACE
  3. JENEVER

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Find Your Bookmaker Handicap
races.verdict:
TOPTIME was below form last time but a return to this venue is an obvious plus (3 course wins to his name) and he gets the tentative vote in a competitive race for the grade. South Parade also needs to bounce back but remains on a good mark, while Marra Donna is interesting on debut for a yard with a good record with similar types.

  1. TOPTIME
  2. SOUTH PARADE (IRE)
  3. MARRA DONNA (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Betting Sites Reviewed Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SHOPAHOLIC produced a career best when winning over 16.5f at Wolverhampton 15 days ago and looks capable of defying a 5 lb rise. Blue Tulip is better on all-weather and rates the main danger after finishing second over this C&D last time, while Astrid can be involved on handicap debut if seeing out this longer trip.

  1. SHOPAHOLIC
  2. BLUE TULIP (IRE)
  3. ASTRID (FR)

races.name: Gowran Park Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
EL CAIROS, a promising novice hurdler last season, probably did well to finish as close as he did having been tight for room on more than one occasion during the latter stages in the Galway Hurdle in July and makes most appeal on these terms. Gaucher has to concede weight all round but arrives fit and in good form from the Flat, so is much respected, while Ebony King is also of interest back in this sphere having showed marked improvement when scoring on the level at Listowel last week.

  1. EL CAIROS (FR)
  2. GAUCHER
  3. EBONY KING (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
4-y-o filly WITCHES FAMILIAR has impressed with the speed she's shown in both her starts to date and is taken to maintain her unbeaten record with the prospect of more to come. Switch From Diesel remains capable of better on this return to hurdling (last seen on the level), while Mino des Mottes is running consistently well and shouldn't be far away once again.

  1. WITCHES FAMILIAR (FR)
  2. SWITCH FROM DIESEL (IRE)
  3. MINO DES MOTTES (FR)

races.name: Jack Duggan Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOONOVERCLOON represents a yard that has won the last 2 renewals of this race and looks to have been laid out for this. He gets the nod, with Mordor and Cobra Queen looking best of the rest.

  1. MOONOVERCLOON (IRE)
  2. MORDOR (FR)
  3. COBRA QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: PWC Danoli Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
BLOOD DESTINY can have his latest effort over hurdles easily overlooked and has to be considered the one to beat on these terms back in this sphere. Fleur In The Park took really well to chasing last season, registering a Grade 1 success in the spring and seems sure to give the selection plenty to think about.

  1. BLOOD DESTINY (FR)
  2. FLEUR IN THE PARK (IRE)
  3. SENECIA (IRE)

races.name: Like A Butterfly Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
A few of these bring potential but Willie Mullins has a fine record in this and his VICAR STREET is fancied to take another step forward and follow up his commanding Galway victory (form worked out well) after a break. Frankie John rates a good prospect too though, and seems sure to go close, while the likeable Shadow Paddy shouldn't be underestimated either in his bid to go 4-4 in this sphere.

  1. VICAR STREET (IRE)
  2. FRANKIE JOHN (IRE)
  3. SHADOW PADDY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Captain Christy Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
FOU DE TOI has left his hurdles form behind in 2 starts over fences, running to a useful level when staying on strongly for a clear-cut success at Kilbeggan last month. He is fancied to score again as he goes back up in distance, though Killaney King could yet do better as a chaser on only his second outing for current yard.

  1. FOU DE TOI (FR)
  2. KILLANEY KING (IRE)
  3. QUANTUM QUEST (IRE)

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
ARCADIAN EMPEROR won a Clonmel maiden hurdle comfortably in April and is taken to make a successful chase debut having been clearly fast-tracked to this sphere. Stablemate Bon Viveur achieved a similar level over hurdles and can be involved if jumping soundly, while Forty Coats and I Started A Joke are also respected.

  1. ARCADIAN EMPEROR (FR)
  2. BON VIVEUR (IRE)
  3. FORTY COATS (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KILLEEMORE LAD wasn’t winning out of turn at Downpatrick in August and is taken to follow up now sent handicapping in this sphere from what looks a very fair opening mark. Recent winner Luimneach arrives on the back of a good second at Wexford and rates the main danger, while Its Bilbo has been running well over hurdles and makes his handicap chase debut off his last winning hurdles mark.

  1. KILLEEMORE LAD (IRE)
  2. LUIMNEACH (IRE)
  3. ITS BILBO (FR)
